Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
This event is all about Cats vs Dogs—because we just can’t agree on which pet should inspire an entire Superdrop next year. That’s why we’re asking you to decide for us.
This drop features the same powerful cards as Dogs Are Better Than Cats, except this version features adorable cat art instead of dog art. These fan-favorite cards can bolster any deck, but buying this drop is also a vote for an ALL CATS SUPERDROP.
If you’re still on the fence, some of our pro-feline employees had this to say about cats:
• Research suggests cats know what you’re saying but just don’t care. That’s cool.
• Knock stuff off your desk so you don’t have to.
• Pspspspspspspsps.
• Won’t do tricks. Not for anybody.
• Instinct for making biscuits.
• Hate lasers. Must destroy lasers.
• Self-cleaning like a dishwasher.
• Zoomies mean you don’t have to set your alarm for 3:00 AM.
Art by Joy Ang, Ashley Mackenzie, Andrea Sipl, Trashkittyart and Erica Williams
Contents:
• 1x Escape to the Wilds
• 1x Rip Apart
• 1x Titanic Ultimatum
• 1x Arcane Signet
• 1x Basilisk Collar
